ex: I commute to work by subway every day.
我每天坐地铁通勤。
The commute takes about an hour each way.
单程通勤大约一小时。
words.tip: com-（共同）+ mute（交换）→ 每天在“家”和“公司”之间交换，即通勤。同根词 mutual。

ex: The deadline for the report is Friday.
报告截止日期是周五。
We barely made the deadline.
我们勉强赶上了截止日期。
words.tip: dead（死）+ line（线）→ 过了这条线就“死”了，即最后期限。

ex: The company will reimburse you for travel expenses.
公司会报销你的差旅费。
Keep the receipts so you can be reimbursed.
保留发票以便报销。
words.tip: re-（回）+ imburse（钱包）→ 钱“回到钱包”，即报销。同根词 purse。

words.def: 主动的，积极的，先发制人的
ex: Be proactive in raising issues before they become problems.
要在问题变大之前主动提出。
She took a proactive approach to her career.
她对自己的职业采取了主动态度。
words.tip: pro-（提前）+ active（行动）→ “提前行动”，即主动。

ex: We need to negotiate a better price with the supplier.
我们需要与供应商谈一个更优惠的价格。
He managed to negotiate a two-day extension.
他成功协商到两天的延期。
words.tip: neg（否定）+ oti（闲暇）→ 没闲工夫闲聊、正经谈事，引申为谈判。

ex: She's always punctual for meetings.
她开会总是很准时。
The train was punctual this morning.
今早火车准点到达。
words.tip: 词根 punct（点）→ 卡着“点”到，即准时。同根词 point。

words.def: 食品杂货；超市买的东西
ex: I need to pick up some groceries on the way home.
我回家路上要买些食品杂货。
The groceries cost more than I expected.
这些东西比我想象的贵。
words.tip: 源自批发商（grosser）“大宗采买”的食物，后泛指日常杂货。

ex: I have a dentist appointment at three.
我三点有个牙医预约。
She was given an appointment as manager.
她被任命为经理。
words.tip: appoint（指定）+ ment → “指定时间见面”，即预约。

ex: I discussed the project with my colleagues.
我和同事们讨论了项目。
She's a former colleague of mine.
她是我以前的同事。
words.tip: col-（共同）+ league（捆绑）→ 绑在一起工作的人，即同事。

ex: Follow the safety procedures at all times.
务必始终遵守安全规程。
The application procedure takes about two weeks.
申请流程大约需要两周。
words.tip: pro-（向前）+ ced（走）+ ure → “向前走的路径”，即流程步骤。

ex: Stop procrastinating and finish the report.
别再拖了，把报告写完。
He procrastinated until the very last minute.
他一直拖到最后一刻。
words.tip: pro-（向前）+ crastinus（明天的）→ 把事“推到明天”，即拖延。

words.def: 一丝不苟的，极其细致的
ex: She is meticulous about keeping records.
她对做记录一丝不苟。
The work requires meticulous attention to detail.
这项工作需要对细节一丝不苟。
words.tip: 词根 metus（恐惧）→ 怕出错而格外仔细，即一丝不苟。

ex: We streamlined the approval process to save time.
我们精简了审批流程以节省时间。
The company streamlined its operations.
公司精简了运营。
words.tip: stream（水流）+ line（线）→ 让流程像流线一样顺畅，即精简优化。

ex: Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?
周五前完成项目可行吗？
The plan is technically feasible but costly.
该计划技术上可行但成本高。
words.tip: 词根 feas（做）→ “做得成”的，即可行。同根词 factory。

ex: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
这家酒店最多可容纳 500 位客人。
We'll try to accommodate your request.
我们会尽量满足你的要求。
words.tip: ac-（去）+ commod（方便）→ 让人方便，即容纳、顺应。

ex: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks.
好经理懂得如何分派任务。
She was delegated to attend the conference.
她被派去参加会议。
words.tip: de-（离开）+ legate（使者）→ 派使者出去，即委派。

ex: Keep your emails concise and to the point.
邮件要简洁切题。
The report gives a concise summary of the findings.
报告对研究结果做了简明总结。
words.tip: con-（加强）+ cis（切）→ 切掉多余的，即简洁。同根词 scissors。

words.def: 优先处理，按重要性排序
ex: We need to prioritize the most urgent tasks first.
我们要优先处理最紧急的任务。
Learn to prioritize your time.
学会安排时间的优先级。
words.tip: priority（优先）+ -ize → 让某事获得优先，即优先处理。

ex: We need to replenish our supplies before the trip.
出发前我们需要补充物资。
The rain replenished the reservoir.
雨水补充了水库。
words.tip: re-（再）+ plen（满）→ 再次装满，即补充。同根词 plenty。

words.def: 连贯的，有条理的；一致的
ex: Your essay needs a more coherent structure.
你的文章需要更连贯的结构。
The team's strategy is coherent and clear.
团队策略连贯清晰。
words.tip: co-（共同）+ here（粘）→ 粘在一起，即连贯。

ex: The new policy helped alleviate traffic congestion.
新政策帮助缓解了交通拥堵。
Talking to a friend can alleviate stress.
和朋友聊聊能缓解压力。
words.tip: al-（去）+ levi（轻，同根 lever）→ 变轻，即减轻。

ex: We need a pragmatic solution, not a perfect one.
我们需要务实的方案，而不是完美的方案。
She took a pragmatic approach to the problem.
她对这个问题采取了务实的做法。
words.tip: 词根 pragma（行动）→ 以做事为导向，即务实。

ex: They reconciled after years of conflict.
多年冲突后他们和解了。
How do you reconcile your career with family life?
你如何兼顾事业与家庭？
words.tip: re-（再）+ concile（召集）→ 重新坐在一起，即和解。

ex: The contract was scrutinized by our lawyers.
合同经过了律师们的仔细审查。
She scrutinized every detail of the plan.
她仔细检查了计划的每个细节。
words.tip: 词根 scrutari（翻找）→ 像翻箱倒柜一样查，即仔细审查。

ex: The board will convene on Monday.
董事会将于周一召开。
The CEO convened an emergency meeting.
CEO 召集了紧急会议。
words.tip: con-（共同）+ vene（来）→ 走到一起来，即召集。同根词 convention。

ex: She embarked on a new career at forty.
她四十岁开始了新的职业生涯。
We're about to embark on a major project.
我们即将启动一个大项目。
words.tip: em-（进入）+ bark（船）→ 登船启程，引申为着手某事。

ex: The new software facilitates communication between teams.
新软件方便了团队之间的沟通。
A mediator was brought in to facilitate the discussion.
请了一位调解人来促成讨论。
words.tip: facil（容易）+ -itate → 让事情变容易，即促进。

ex: Insurance can mitigate the financial impact of accidents.
保险可以减轻事故的财务影响。
We took steps to mitigate the risks.
我们采取措施降低风险。
words.tip: miti（温和）+ gate（驱动）→ 让事情温和下来，即缓解。

words.def: 模棱两可的，含糊不清的
ex: The wording of the contract is ambiguous.
合同措辞含糊不清。
His answer was deliberately ambiguous.
他的回答故意模棱两可。
words.tip: ambi-（两边）+ gu（走）→ 可往两边走，即模棱两可。

ex: She cultivated a habit of reading every morning.
她养成了每天早晨阅读的习惯。
He's trying to cultivate relationships with clients.
他正在培养与客户的关系。
words.tip: 词根 cult（耕作，同根 culture）→ 像种地一样培育，即培养。

ex: Many experts advocate a balanced diet.
许多专家提倡均衡饮食。
She's a strong advocate of renewable energy.
她是可再生能源的坚定倡导者。
words.tip: ad-（向）+ voc（喊，同根 voice）→ 为其发声，即提倡。

ex: He contemplated changing his career.
他考虑过转行。
She sat silently contemplating the view.
她静静地坐着凝视风景。
words.tip: con-（加强）+ templ（庙宇）→ 像在神庙里沉思，即深思。

words.def: 有韧性的，能迅速恢复的
ex: Children are often more resilient than adults.
孩子往往比大人更有韧性。
The economy proved resilient despite the crisis.
尽管危机重重，经济表现出韧性。
words.tip: re-（回）+ sil（跳）→ 弹回去，即恢复力强。

ex: The project requires a substantial investment.
项目需要大量投资。
There was a substantial improvement in sales.
销售有了显著提升。
words.tip: substance（实质）+ -ial → 有实打实分量的，即大量。

ex: She's a versatile actress who can play any role.
她是位能演任何角色的多才多艺的演员。
This versatile tool can cut, slice and peel.
这个多功能工具能切、能片、能削皮。
words.tip: vers（转）+ -atile → 能转向多种用途，即多才多艺。同根词 version。

ex: She articulated her concerns clearly at the meeting.
她在会上清楚地表达了她的担忧。
He's an articulate speaker.
他是个善于表达的演讲者。
words.tip: articul（关节）+ -ate → 话像关节一样一节节清晰，即清晰表达。

ex: Prices fluctuate with supply and demand.
价格随供需波动。
Her mood fluctuates between hope and despair.
她的情绪在希望与绝望之间起伏。
words.tip: 词根 fluct（流）→ 像水流一样上下浮动，即波动。

ex: Bonuses are a strong incentive for employees.
奖金是对员工的强大激励。
There's little incentive to save money these days.
如今存钱的动力很小。
words.tip: in-（向内）+ cent（唱）→ 在心里唱起来，激发动力，即激励。

ex: She was reluctant to admit her mistake.
她不愿承认错误。
He gave a reluctant agreement.
他勉强同意了。
words.tip: re-（相反）+ luct（挣扎）→ 内心挣扎着抵抗，即不情愿。

ex: Rumors can undermine team morale.
谣言会削弱团队士气。
His actions undermined her confidence.
他的行为损害了她的信心。
words.tip: under（下）+ mine（挖）→ 在底下挖，即暗中破坏、削弱。

ex: The plane deviated from its original route.
飞机偏离了原定航线。
Don't deviate from the plan without consulting me.
未经我商量不要偏离计划。
words.tip: de-（离开）+ vi（路）→ 离开正路，即偏离。同根词 via。

ex: They made elaborate preparations for the wedding.
他们为婚礼做了精心的准备。
Could you elaborate on that point?
你能详细阐述一下那一点吗？
words.tip: e-（出）+ labor（劳动）→ 付出大量劳动做出来，即精心制作/详述。

ex: The company will implement the new policy next month.
公司将于下月实施新政策。
We need a plan we can actually implement.
我们需要一个能真正落实的计划。
words.tip: im-（进入）+ ple（满）→ 填满到位，即落实执行。

ex: She's proficient in three languages.
她精通三门语言。
He became proficient at using the software.
他熟练掌握了该软件。
words.tip: pro-（向前）+ fic（做）→ 做得往前一步，即精通。同根词 efficient。

words.def: 坚持不懈的；持续存在的
ex: Persistent effort leads to success.
坚持不懈的努力带来成功。
He's been persistent in pursuing his dream.
他一直坚持不懈地追求梦想。
words.tip: per-（一直）+ sist（站）→ 一直站着不放弃，即坚持不懈。同根词 consist。

ex: To be candid, I think the proposal has some serious flaws.
坦率地说，我认为这份方案存在一些严重缺陷。
She gave a candid assessment of the team's performance.
她对团队表现给出了坦诚的评价。
words.tip: 词根 cand-（白、发光）→ 心里亮堂堂不藏黑，即坦荡直率。同根词 candle。

ex: The accountant found a discrepancy between the invoice and the bank statement.
会计发现发票与银行对账单之间存在差异。
There's a discrepancy between what was promised and what was delivered.
承诺的和实际交付的对不上。
words.tip: dis-（分开）+ crep（破裂）→ 两样东西裂开各说各话，即对不上号。

words.def: 阻止，威慑（deter sb from doing）
ex: Higher parking fees are meant to deter people from driving into the city.
提高停车费是为了阻止人们开车进城。
The high price tag didn't deter buyers from lining up overnight.
高昂的价格并没有吓退通宵排队的买家。
words.tip: de-（加强）+ ter（吓唬，同根 terror）→ 吓得你退回去，即威慑。

ex: Anxiety is pervasive among students during exam season.
考试季焦虑在学生中普遍存在。
The influence of social media is so pervasive that it shapes how we think.
社交媒体的影响无处不在，甚至塑造了我们的思维方式。
words.tip: per-（遍及）+ vade（走，同根 invade）→ 走遍每个角落，即无处不在。

ex: She is a tenacious negotiator who never gives up a key demand.
她是个顽强的谈判者，从不放弃关键诉求。
Despite three failed attempts, his tenacious attitude finally paid off.
尽管失败了三次，他顽强的态度最终得到了回报。
words.tip: 词根 ten-（握住，同根 tenant）→ 死死抓住不松手，即坚韧。

words.def: 维持；支撑；遭受（损失、伤害）
ex: The economy cannot sustain this level of growth forever.
经济无法永远维持这种增长速度。
Several buildings sustained severe damage in the earthquake.
几栋建筑在地震中遭受了严重损坏。
We need more funding to sustain the project long-term.
我们需要更多资金来长期维持这个项目。
words.tip: sus-（自下而上）+ tain（握持）→ 从下面托住，即维持。同根词 maintain、contain。

words.def: 招致；蒙受（费用、债务、损失）
ex: Any delay will incur additional costs.
任何延误都会产生额外费用。
The company incurred heavy losses last quarter.
公司上季度蒙受了重大损失。
He incurred a fine for parking in a restricted area.
他在禁停区停车而被罚款。
words.tip: in-（进入）+ cur（跑）→ 跑进麻烦里，即招致。cur 同根：occur（发生）、current（流动的）。

ex: The two firms consolidated to form a single company.
两家公司合并组成了一家公司。
She took time off to consolidate her position before the election.
选举前她休假来巩固自己的地位。
The company consolidated its overseas operations.
公司合并了海外业务。
words.tip: con-（一起）+ solid（坚固）+ -ate → 使一起变坚固，即巩固。solid 同根。

ex: This view is prevalent among young people.
这种观点在年轻人中很普遍。
Dengue fever is prevalent in tropical regions.
登革热在热带地区流行。
Identity theft has become increasingly prevalent online.
网络身份盗窃变得越来越普遍。
words.tip: pre-（前面）+ val（力量）+ -ent → 力量压在前面、占主导，即普遍流行。val 同根：value、valid。

words.def: 谨慎的；言行得体的；不显眼的
ex: Please keep the matter discreet.
请对这件事谨慎保密。
He made a discreet exit from the party.
他悄无声息地离开了聚会。
The hotel offers discreet service for VIP guests.
这家酒店为贵宾提供贴心的低调服务。
words.tip: dis-（分开）+ creet（分辨）→ 能分辨分寸，即谨慎。别和 discrete（离散的）混淆：discreet 指“嘴严”，discrete 指“分离”。

ex: The glass survived the fall intact.
玻璃杯摔下来却完好无损。
Despite the fire, the building's structure remained intact.
尽管发生火灾，大楼结构依然完好。
Her reputation remained intact after the scandal.
丑闻之后她的名誉依然无损。
words.tip: in-（不）+ tact（接触）→ 没有被碰过，即完好。tact 同根：contact（接触）、tactile（触觉的）。

ex: The company allegedly violated environmental regulations.
该公司据称违反了环保法规。
He allegedly stole classified documents.
他据称窃取了机密文件。
The star was allegedly involved in a bribery scandal.
这位明星据称卷入了一起贿赂丑闻。
words.tip: allege（宣称）+ -ly；新闻高频词，用在未经证实的指控前。词根 leg-（法律）→ “在法律上宣称”。

ex: Solar power is a viable alternative to fossil fuels.
太阳能是化石燃料的可行替代方案。
The committee concluded that the plan was not economically viable.
委员会认定该计划在经济上不可行。
The startup needs a viable business model to attract investors.
这家初创公司需要可行的商业模式来吸引投资者。
words.tip: via（路）+ -able → 有路可走，即可行。同根：via（经由）、deviate（偏离）。

ex: It would be prudent to save some money for emergencies.
存些钱以备不时之需是明智的。
A prudent investor diversifies.
谨慎的投资者会分散投资。
The government took prudent measures to control inflation.
政府采取审慎措施控制通胀。
words.tip: prud = prov（预见）→ 有远见、想得长远，即谨慎明智。联想 provident（有远见的）。

ex: The committee concurred with the recommendation.
委员会同意这项建议。
Experts concur that the policy is effective.
专家们一致认为这项政策有效。
The two events concurred on the same day.
两件事碰巧在同一天发生。
words.tip: con-（一起）+ cur（跑）→ 一起跑，即意见一致 / 同时发生。cur 同根：occur（发生）、current（当前的）。

ex: The conflict between the two countries threatens to escalate into a full-scale war.
两国之间的冲突有可能升级为全面战争。
If the customer is still unhappy, please escalate the issue to your line manager.
如果客户仍然不满意，请把问题上报给你的直属经理。
Prices escalated rapidly during the housing boom.
房地产繁荣期间房价迅速攀升。
words.tip: 词根 e(s)-（出）+ scala（阶梯，同源 escalator 扶梯）→ 沿着阶梯逐级往上走，事情一步步变严重。

ex: The company is required by law to disclose its financial records to shareholders.
法律要求公司向股东披露财务记录。
He refused to disclose the source of his information.
他拒绝透露消息来源。
The report discloses a series of safety violations at the plant.
报告披露了该工厂一系列安全隐患。
words.tip: dis-（打开）+ close（关闭）→ 把关闭的东西打开，即公开、披露。与 enclose（封闭）反义。

words.def: 即将发生的；迫在眉睫的
ex: Residents were warned that flooding was imminent and to move to higher ground.
居民被警告洪水即将来临，需转移到高处。
The company announced the imminent launch of its new product line.
公司宣布新产品线即将发布。
Talks broke down amid fears that a strike was imminent.
谈判破裂，人们担心罢工迫在眉睫。
words.tip: im-（进入）+ min（突出、悬垂）→ 危险悬在头顶，即迫在眉睫。与 eminent（杰出的）区分：e- 出来 → 出类拔萃。

ex: The country has been in political turmoil since the disputed election.
自选举争议以来，该国一直处于政治动荡之中。
His mind was in turmoil after receiving the unexpected news.
收到这个意外消息后，他内心一片混乱。
Markets plunged amid global economic turmoil.
全球经济动荡中市场暴跌。
words.tip: tur-（转动）+ moil（搅拌）→ 像搅拌机一样翻搅，即混乱。画面感：洗衣机滚筒里翻滚的衣服——乱成一团。

ex: The country is going through a period of social upheaval.
这个国家正经历一段社会剧变时期。
Moving abroad caused a major upheaval in their family life.
移居国外给他们的家庭生活带来了巨大动荡。
The industry has seen tremendous upheaval with the rise of AI.
随着人工智能崛起，该行业经历了巨大的变革。
words.tip: up-（向上）+ heave（举起）→ 从底下被猛地掀翻，即剧变。画面：地壳被掀翻隆起，一切秩序都被打乱。

words.def: 固有的；内在的；与生俱来的
ex: There are inherent risks in any investment.
任何投资都有固有的风险。
The design has inherent flaws that cannot be easily fixed.
这个设计存在难以修复的固有缺陷。
She has an inherent ability to stay calm under pressure.
她天生具备压力下保持冷静的能力。
words.tip: in-（在内）+ her（粘住，同根 adhere 粘附）→ 粘在里面的、长在骨子里的，即固有的。

words.def: 实证的；以观察或实验为依据的
ex: The theory is supported by empirical evidence from dozens of studies.
该理论得到数十项研究实证证据的支持。
Researchers need empirical data before drawing any conclusions.
研究人员在下结论前需要实证数据。
There is little empirical research on this topic.
关于这个话题的实证研究很少。
words.tip: 来自希腊语 empeiria（经验）→ 靠亲身经验与实验说话，即实证的。联想 experience（经验）同源。

ex: His explanation sounds plausible, but I still have doubts.
他的解释听起来有道理，但我仍有疑虑。
The police found a plausible motive for the crime.
警方找到了一个貌似合理的犯罪动机。
We need a plausible strategy, not just wishful thinking.
我们需要一个行得通的策略，而不是一厢情愿。
words.tip: plaus（鼓掌，同根 applaud 喝彩）→ 讲得让人想鼓掌，看似可信。注意：常暗含“只是貌似有理”，要留个心眼。

words.def: 分配；划拨（资源、时间、资金）
ex: The government will allocate additional funds to public healthcare.
政府将向公共医疗划拨额外资金。
Managers must allocate their time wisely across multiple projects.
经理们必须在多个项目间明智地分配时间。
Each team was allocated a specific budget for the quarter.
每个团队都分到了本季度的专项预算。
words.tip: al-（向）+ loc（地方，同根 local 本地的）→ 把东西放到各自的位置，即分配。

ex: We need to consult all stakeholders before making the final decision.
在做最终决定前，我们需要咨询所有利益相关者。
Employees, customers and investors are all key stakeholders of the company.
员工、客户和投资者都是公司的关键利益相关者。
The project failed because key stakeholders were not on board.
项目失败是因为关键利益相关者没有参与进来。
words.tip: stake（股份、赌注）+ holder（持有者）→ 手里握着利益的人。画面：牌桌上握着筹码的人，输赢都跟他有关。

words.def: 瀑布般倾泻；（事情）接连发生，层层传递；一连串
ex: The scandal sent a cascade of resignations through the company.
丑闻引发公司一连串的辞职。
When one server fails, the error cascades to the whole system.
一台服务器出故障，错误会波及整个系统。
Water cascaded down the rocks after the storm.
暴雨后，水从岩石上倾泻而下。
words.tip: cas（落下）+cade → 像瀑布一样哗啦啦往下落 → 接连发生。联想：单词瀑布从山上逐级流下。

ex: His health deteriorated rapidly after the operation.
手术后他的健康迅速恶化。
Relations between the two countries continued to deteriorate.
两国关系持续恶化。
The weather is expected to deteriorate over the weekend.
预计周末天气会转坏。
words.tip: deterior（拉丁语“更坏的”）+ -ate 动词后缀 → 变得更坏 → 恶化。

words.def: 全面的；综合的；包罗万象的
ex: The report gives a comprehensive overview of the market.
报告对市场作了全面的概述。
We offer a comprehensive range of services to our clients.
我们为客户提供全面的服务。
She underwent a comprehensive medical examination.
她接受了全面的体检。
words.tip: com（全部）+ prehend（抓住）+ -sive → 全部抓住的 → 面面俱到的 → 全面的。

words.def: 可能发生的事；意外事故；应急措施
ex: We need a contingency plan in case the deal falls through.
我们需要一个应急预案，以防交易落空。
The company set aside funds for unforeseen contingencies.
公司为不可预见的意外情况预留了资金。
Firefighters train for every possible contingency.
消防员为一切可能的突发状况进行训练。
words.tip: con（共同）+ ting（接触）+ -ency → 意外撞上来的事 → 不测事件。职场必备：contingency plan（应急预案）。

ex: The program aims to foster creativity in young students.
该项目旨在培养学生的创造力。
Good communication fosters trust between colleagues.
良好的沟通能促进同事间的信任。
They decided to foster a child from the local orphanage.
他们决定收养当地孤儿院的一个孩子。
words.tip: foster family（寄养家庭）→ 用爱“喂养”孩子 → 引申为培养、促进。

words.def: 杠杆作用；影响力；利用（资源、优势）
ex: We can leverage our existing customer base to enter new markets.
我们可以利用现有客户群进入新市场。
The union used its leverage to negotiate better wages.
工会利用自身影响力争取更高的工资。
Small businesses often lack the financial leverage to expand.
小企业往往缺乏扩张所需的财务杠杆。
words.tip: lever（杠杆）+ age → 用杠杆撬动资源 → 利用。商务高频搭配：leverage data / leverage strengths。

words.def: 有形的；可触摸的；切实的
ex: The project has produced tangible results in just six months.
项目仅半年就产生了切实的成果。
Tangible assets include buildings, equipment and cash.
有形资产包括建筑、设备和现金。
We need a tangible reward to motivate the team.
我们需要切实的奖励来激励团队。
words.tip: tang（触摸，与 contact 同源）+ -ible（可…的）→ 摸得着的 → 有形的。反义词 intangible（无形的）。

words.def: 透明的；显而易见的；坦诚的
ex: The company promised to be transparent about its data practices.
公司承诺在数据处理方面保持透明。
The whole process was transparent and fair.
整个过程公开透明、公平公正。
His transparent attempt to flatter me made everyone uncomfortable.
他毫不掩饰的奉承让所有人都不自在。
words.tip: trans（穿过）+ parent（显现）→ 光能穿过去 → 透明的 → 引申为坦诚、公开。

ex: Trust underpins every successful business relationship.
信任是一切成功商业关系的基础。
The evidence underpins the theory that exercise boosts memory.
该证据支持“锻炼增强记忆”的理论。
Strong public investment underpins long-term economic growth.
强劲的公共投资支撑着长期经济增长。
words.tip: under（在下面）+ pin（钉住）→ 在下面钉住 → 托底支撑 → 巩固、奠定基础。

words.def: 养育；培育；培养；（n.）养育；教养
ex: Parents should nurture their children's curiosity.
父母应培养孩子的好奇心。
The company nurtures young talent through its internship program.
公司通过实习项目培养年轻人才。
Nature and nurture both shape who we become.
天性和后天教养共同塑造了我们。
words.tip: 与 nurse（照料）同源 → 像照料婴儿一样精心培育 → 培养、养育。

words.def: 规避，绕过（规则、障碍、困难）
ex: Companies often try to circumvent tax regulations through loopholes.
公司常试图通过法律漏洞规避税收法规。
We can circumvent the traffic jam by taking the back roads.
我们可以走小路绕过交通堵塞。
The new system was designed to circumvent security flaws.
新系统旨在绕过安全漏洞。
words.tip: circum-（环绕，同根 circumference 圆周）+ vent（来）→ 绕着走、不正面撞上，即规避。

words.def: 不停的，不间断的；坚持不懈的；无情的
ex: The relentless rain caused severe flooding in the low-lying areas.
连绵不断的暴雨在低洼地区引发了严重洪灾。
Her relentless pursuit of excellence earned her the promotion.
她对卓越的不懈追求为她赢得了晋升。
The team faced relentless pressure from competitors.
团队承受着来自竞争对手的无情压力。
words.tip: relent（心软）+ less（不）→ 不心软、不停歇，即无情/不停。画面：永不停歇的暴雨。

ex: The main drawback of working from home is the lack of face-to-face interaction.
在家办公的主要缺点是缺乏面对面交流。
High maintenance costs are a significant drawback of this equipment.
高昂的维护成本是这台设备的一大缺点。
Despite its drawbacks, the plan is still worth trying.
尽管有缺点，这个计划仍值得一试。
words.tip: draw（拉）+ back（回）→ 把你往后拉的力，即不利因素。联想：drawback 是 pullback（后拉力）。

ex: The committee endorsed the proposal after a long discussion.
委员会经过长时间讨论后赞同了该提案。
Several celebrities endorse this brand on social media.
多位明星在社交媒体上为该品牌代言。
The study endorses the effectiveness of regular exercise.
该研究支持定期锻炼的有效性。
words.tip: en-（使）+ dorse（背面）→ 在文件背面签字表示认可，即背书、支持。

words.def: 临时的，过渡的；过渡期，间歇
ex: An interim CEO was appointed while the board searched for a permanent candidate.
董事会在寻找正式人选期间任命了一位临时CEO。
The report will be released in the interim before the final results come out.
报告将在最终结果出来前的过渡期发布。
In the interim, we should focus on stabilizing our cash flow.
在此期间，我们应该专注于稳定现金流。
words.tip: inter-（在…之间）+ im → 在两个阶段“之间”的，即临时的、过渡的。

words.def: 臭名昭著的，声名狼藉的（多含贬义）
ex: The city is notorious for its traffic congestion.
这座城市因交通拥堵而声名狼藉。
He is a notorious hacker who has been arrested twice.
他是个两次被捕的臭名昭著的黑客。
The restaurant is notorious for its poor service.
这家餐厅以服务差而闻名。
words.tip: not（知道）+ -orious → 人人都知道（而且是坏事），即臭名昭著。与 famous 区别：notorious 带贬义。

ex: World leaders denounced the attack in strong terms.
世界各国领导人强烈谴责这次袭击。
The union denounced the company's decision to cut wages.
工会公开抨击公司降薪的决定。
She denounced the report as misleading.
她抨击这份报道具有误导性。
words.tip: de-（向下）+ nounce（说，同根 announce）→ 向下大声说（坏事），即谴责。

ex: She oversees a team of twenty engineers.
她负责管理一支二十人的工程师团队。
The project was overseen by the vice president.
该项目由副总裁监督。
A government agency oversees food safety standards.
一家政府机构负责监管食品安全标准。
words.tip: over（在上方）+ see（看）→ 站在高处看着全局，即监管。联想 oversee 与 supervisor（主管）同源。

ex: The conference offers simultaneous interpretation in six languages.
会议提供六种语言的同声传译。
The two attacks were simultaneous, which puzzled investigators.
两起袭击同时发生，令调查人员困惑。
We need to ensure simultaneous updates across all devices.
我们需要确保所有设备同步更新。
words.tip: simul（相同，同根 similar）+ -taneous → 在同一时间，即同时的。simultaneous interpretation 同声传译。

ex: The noise level exceeded the acceptable threshold.
噪音水平超过了可接受的阈值。
Low-income families below the threshold receive government subsidies.
低于门槛线的低收入家庭可获得政府补贴。
We are on the threshold of a major breakthrough.
我们正处于重大突破的起点。
words.tip: thresh（踩踏）+ hold（握住）→ 门口踩踏的地方，即门槛。引申为界限、阈值。

ex: The journalist could not substantiate her claims with evidence.
记者无法用证据证实她的说法。
Researchers must substantiate their findings before publication.
研究人员必须在发表前证实他们的发现。
The theory has never been substantiated by experiment.
该理论从未得到实验证实。
words.tip: substance（实质）+ -ate → 让说法有“实质”支撑，即证实。

ex: After losing three games, the team finally conceded defeat.
连输三场后，球队最终承认失败。
The manager conceded that the deadline was unrealistic.
经理承认截止日期不现实。
He conceded the point to his opponent.
他在这点上向对手让步了。
words.tip: con-（一起）+ cede（退，同根 proceed）→ 往后退、认输，即承认/让步。

words.def: 逐渐减少，缩小， dwindling 日益减少的
ex: Water supplies dwindled during the long drought.
长期干旱期间供水不断减少。
Support for the policy has dwindled in recent months.
近几个月对该政策的支持逐渐下降。
The crowd dwindled to a handful of people.
人群减少到只剩几个人。
words.tip: 谐音“叮当”→ 硬币越来越少，“叮当”声渐弱，即逐渐减少。

words.def: 前所未有的，史无前例的
ex: The pandemic caused unprecedented disruption to global trade.
疫情给全球贸易造成了前所未有的干扰。
The company saw unprecedented growth this year.
公司今年实现了前所未有的增长。
The deal was completed at unprecedented speed.
这笔交易以空前的速度完成。
words.tip: un-（没有）+ precedent（先例）+ -ed → 没有先例的，即史无前例。

words.def: 授权，委托；命令，强制执行
ex: The government has a mandate to implement the new policy.
政府获授权执行这项新政策。
The new law mandates that all drivers wear seat belts.
新法律规定所有驾驶员必须系安全带。
The election gave the party a clear mandate for reform.
选举赋予该党明确的改革授权。
words.tip: man（手）+ date（给）→ 交到手上的任务，即授权、命令。

ex: All employees must adhere to the company's code of conduct.
所有员工必须遵守公司行为准则。
The bandage adhered firmly to the skin.
绷带牢牢粘在皮肤上。
We adhered strictly to the original plan.
我们严格遵守原定计划。
words.tip: ad-（向）+ here（粘）→ 粘上去不脱离，即遵守/粘附。

ex: The new tax policy is highly controversial.
新税收政策极具争议。
She made a controversial decision to cut funding.
她做出了削减资金的争议性决定。
The book remains controversial decades after publication.
这本书出版几十年后仍具争议。
words.tip: contro-（相反）+ vers（转）→ 大家往相反方向转、各执一词，即有争议。

ex: The delay only exacerbated the problem.
延误只会使问题恶化。
Cutting staff may exacerbate the current crisis.
裁员可能加剧当前危机。
Stress can exacerbate existing health conditions.
压力会加剧已有的健康问题。
words.tip: ex-（出）+ acerb（酸涩）+ -ate → 让味道更酸涩，即使之恶化。

ex: It's futile to argue with someone who won't listen.
和一个不听劝的人争论是徒劳的。
They made a futile attempt to rescue the trapped miners.
他们试图营救被困矿工，但徒劳无功。
The negotiations proved futile in the end.
谈判最终被证明是徒劳的。
words.tip: fut（流出）+ -ile → 像水一样流走、抓不住，即徒劳。

ex: An impartial judge is essential for a fair trial.
公正的法官对公正审判至关重要。
The committee must remain impartial when reviewing applications.
委员会在审查申请时必须保持公正。
We need impartial advice on this matter.
这件事我们需要公正的建议。
words.tip: im-（不）+ partial（偏袒的）→ 不偏袒任何一方，即公正。

ex: The company has a legitimate claim to the patent.
公司对该专利拥有合法权利。
She raised legitimate concerns about the project's cost.
她对项目成本提出了合理的担忧。
Is this a legitimate business or a scam?
这是正规生意还是骗局？
words.tip: 词根 legitim（法律）→ 法律认可的，即合法/正当。

words.def: 微小的，少量的；边缘的，非主流的
ex: The new policy had only a marginal effect on prices.
新政策对价格影响甚微。
He was a marginal candidate with little support.
他是一位支持率很低的边缘候选人。
The changes produced a marginal improvement in sales.
这些变化使销售略有改善。
words.tip: margin（边缘）+ -al → 处在边缘、只有一点点，即微小的。

words.def: 迫使，责成；施恩于，帮…的忙
ex: The law obliges companies to report data breaches.
法律要求公司报告数据泄露事件。
Would you oblige me by closing the window?
能麻烦您帮我关一下窗吗？
I'd be obliged if you kept this confidential.
如果你能保密，我将不胜感激。
words.tip: ob-（朝向）+ lige（绑）→ 被“绑”住不得不做，即迫使。be obliged 感激的。

ex: The ruling set a legal precedent for similar cases.
该裁决为类似案件确立了法律先例。
There is no precedent for such a decision.
这样的决定没有先例可循。
The company broke with precedent by hiring an outsider as CEO.
公司打破惯例，聘请外人担任CEO。
words.tip: pre-（前）+ cede（走）→ 走在前面可参照的事，即先例。

words.def: 下级的，次要的；下属，下级
ex: He delegated the task to his subordinates.
他把任务分派给下属。
A good manager listens to subordinates' feedback.
好的经理会倾听下属的反馈。
In the army, rank determines who is subordinate to whom.
军队里，军衔决定谁是谁的下级。
words.tip: sub-（下）+ ordinate（顺序）→ 排在下面的，即下级。同根 order（顺序）。

ex: Consumers perceive the brand as trustworthy.
消费者认为这个品牌值得信赖。
The noise was so faint that nobody perceived it.
那声音太微弱了，没人察觉到。
I perceive a subtle change in his attitude.
我察觉到他的态度有微妙的变化。
words.tip: per-（完全）+ceive（拿住）→ 完全接收到信息 → 察觉、感知

ex: She was overwhelmed by the amount of work.
她被繁重的工作压得喘不过气。
The home team was overwhelmed by the visitors' attack.
主队被客队的攻势打得难以招架。
A wave of emotion overwhelmed him.
一股情绪涌上心头，让他难以自持。
words.tip: over（在上）+whelm（淹没）→ 水盖过头顶 → 压倒、不知所措

words.def: 断言；主张；维护（权利/权威）
ex: She asserted that the report was inaccurate.
她断言这份报告不准确。
He needs to assert his authority in the meeting.
他需要在会议上维护自己的权威。
The defendant asserted his right to a fair trial.
被告主张自己享有公正审判的权利。
words.tip: as-（向）+sert（加入）→ 把观点摆上台面 → 断言、主张

words.def: 明确的；直率的；清楚详尽的
ex: The contract states the terms explicitly.
合同明确列出了各项条款。
Could you be more explicit about your requirements?
你能把要求说得更明确些吗？
He was explicit in his criticism of the policy.
他直言不讳地批评这项政策。
words.tip: ex-（向外）+plicit（折叠）→ 把话摊开说 → 明确、直白（反义词 implicit 含蓄的）

ex: She faced the dilemma of career or family.
她面临事业与家庭的两难选择。
The government is in a dilemma over tax reform.
政府在税收改革上进退两难。
Managers often face the dilemma of quality versus cost.
管理者常面临质量与成本的两难。
words.tip: di-（两个）+lemma（假设）→ 两条路都难走 → 两难困境

ex: We need to expedite the shipment to meet the deadline.
我们需要加快发货以赶上截止日期。
The bank expedited the loan approval.
银行加快了贷款审批。
Please expedite the review of this application.
请加快处理这份申请的审核。
words.tip: ex-（向外）+ped（脚）→ 脚迈得更快 → 加速（同根 pedestrian 行人）

ex: The wine complements the meal perfectly.
这款酒和这顿饭搭配得恰到好处。
Online courses complement traditional classroom learning.
在线课程是对传统课堂学习的补充。
The two teams' skills complement each other well.
两支队伍的技能优势互补。
words.tip: com-（共同）+ple（填满）→ 互相填满缺口 → 互补（别和 compliment“赞美”混淆）

ex: No one may use your data without your consent.
未经你的同意，任何人都不得使用你的数据。
She consented to the surgery.
她同意接受手术。
Parents must give their consent for the school trip.
学校组织出游必须征得家长同意。
words.tip: con-（共同）+sent（感觉）→ 感觉一致 → 同意（同根 sentiment 情感）

ex: His arrival coincided with the start of the storm.
他到达时正好暴风雨开始。
Our views on this issue coincide.
我们对这个问题的看法一致。
The conference coincides with the national holiday.
会议正好赶上国庆假期。
words.tip: co-（共同）+incide（落下）→ 一起落下 → 同时发生、相符

ex: The government intervened to stabilize prices.
政府出手干预以稳定物价。
A referee intervened to stop the fight.
裁判介入制止了打斗。
He intervened in the argument to calm things down.
他在争吵中插话以缓和局面。
words.tip: inter-（之间）+vene（来）→ 插到中间来 → 介入、干预（同根 venue 场地）

ex: All staff must comply with safety regulations.
所有员工必须遵守安全规定。
The company failed to comply with the court order.
公司未能遵守法院命令。
Failure to comply may result in a fine.
不遵守规定可能被处以罚款。
words.tip: com-（完全）+ply（填满）→ 把要求填满做到 → 遵从（名词 compliance）

ex: He acknowledged his mistake in public.
他公开承认了自己的错误。
We should acknowledge the support of our sponsors.
我们应当感谢赞助商的支持。
Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
收到此邮件请回复确认。
words.tip: ac-（向）+knowledge（知道）→ 把知道的当众说出来 → 承认、致谢

ex: The strike disrupted train services nationwide.
罢工导致全国铁路服务中断。
New technology has disrupted traditional industries.
新技术颠覆了传统行业。
The storm disrupted power supplies for hours.
暴风雨导致供电中断数小时。
words.tip: dis-（分开）+rupt（断裂）→ 把流程弄断 → 扰乱、中断（同根 erupt 爆发）

ex: Poor management could jeopardise the entire project.
管理不善可能危及整个项目。
She refused to jeopardise her career for a quick profit.
她拒绝为眼前利益损害自己的职业生涯。
The scandal jeopardised his reputation.
丑闻损害了他的名声。
words.tip: 词源 jeu parti（法语：赌局）→ 把…押上赌桌 → 危及、冒险

words.def: 导航；驾驶；成功应对（复杂局面）
ex: He navigated the ship through the narrow channel.
他驾驶轮船穿过狭窄的航道。
She navigated the company through a difficult year.
她带领公司度过了艰难的一年。
Use the app to navigate around the city.
用这个应用在城市里导航。
words.tip: nav（船）+ig（引导）→ 引船前行 → 导航、应对（同根 navy 海军）

ex: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
会议戛然而止。
His abrupt manner made people uncomfortable.
他唐突的态度让人不舒服。
The bus made an abrupt stop.
公交车突然急刹。
words.tip: ab-（离开）+rupt（断裂）→ 突然断裂 → 突然的（同根 erupt 爆发）

ex: The donation was made by an anonymous benefactor.
这笔捐款来自一位匿名捐赠者。
Users can post comments anonymously.
用户可以匿名发表评论。
words.tip: an-（无）+onym（名字）+ous → 没有名字的 → 匿名的（同根 synonym 同义词）

ex: The government introduced new measures to bolster the economy.
政府出台新措施提振经济。
His confidence was bolstered by the praise.
赞扬增强了他的信心。
words.tip: 联想 bol（球）+ster → 像靠垫一样撑住 → 支撑、加强

ex: The company reported a major data breach.
公司报告了一起严重的数据泄露。
He was sued for breach of contract.
他因违约被起诉。
words.tip: 联想 beach（海滩）→ 海浪在堤坝上冲开缺口 → 缺口、违反

ex: A quiet environment is conducive to concentration.
安静的环境有助于集中注意力。
The manager tried to create a workplace conducive to innovation.
经理努力营造有利于创新的工作环境。
words.tip: con-（共同）+duc（引导）+ive → 一起引导向好的方向 → 有助于

ex: Budget constraints forced us to postpone the project.
预算限制迫使我们推迟项目。
Time is a major constraint in this task.
时间是这个任务的主要限制。
words.tip: con-（一起）+strain（拉紧）→ 被拉紧 → 约束（同根 restrain 抑制）

ex: The airline curtailed its services due to the crisis.
航空公司在危机期间缩减了服务。
We must curtail unnecessary spending.
我们必须削减不必要的开支。
words.tip: cur（短）+tail（尾巴）→ 把尾巴剪短 → 削减

ex: Moving to a new country can be daunting.
移居新国家可能令人望而生畏。
The task ahead looks daunting but achievable.
面前的任务看似艰巨，但可以完成。
words.tip: daunt（使气馁）+ing → 让人气馁的 → 令人却步

ex: The pain gradually diminished over time.
疼痛随时间逐渐减轻。
His influence has diminished in recent years.
近年来他的影响力减弱了。
words.tip: di-（向下）+min（小）+ish → 越来越小 → 减少（同根 minimum）

ex: The interviewer elicited useful information from the witness.
采访者从证人那里套出了有用信息。
The proposal elicited strong reactions from the public.
该提案引发了公众强烈反响。
words.tip: e-（向外）+licit（引诱）→ 引诱出来 → 引出（区别于 illicit 非法的）

ex: The company formulated a new marketing strategy.
公司制定了一项新营销战略。
She struggled to formulate her thoughts clearly.
她努力清楚地表达自己的想法。
words.tip: form（形式）+ulate → 把想法变成形式 → 制定、阐述

ex: Heavy snow hampered rescue efforts.
大雪阻碍了救援工作。
Lack of funding hampered the research.
资金不足妨碍了研究进展。
words.tip: 联想 hamper（有盖的大篮子）→ 大篮子挡路 → 阻碍

ex: The new system needs to be integrated with existing software.
新系统需要与现有软件整合。
Immigrants often struggle to integrate into a new society.
移民常常难以融入新社会。
words.tip: integr（完整）+ate → 使完整 → 整合（同根 integral 完整的）

ex: The campaign gained momentum after the endorsement.
获得支持后，这场运动势头大增。
The team carried its momentum into the next game.
球队带着这股势头进入下一场比赛。
words.tip: 联想 moment（时刻）→ 每个时刻都在推进 → 势头、动力

ex: The decision provoked widespread criticism.
这一决定引发了广泛批评。
Don't provoke the dog.
别招惹那条狗。
words.tip: pro-（向前）+voke（喊叫）→ 冲着…喊 → 激怒、激起（同根 vocal 声音）

words.def: 强制实行；征收（税）；把…强加于
ex: The government imposed new tariffs on imported steel.
政府对进口钢材征收了新关税。
Parents shouldn't impose their own ambitions on their children.
父母不应把自己的抱负强加给孩子。
Strict limits were imposed on car traffic in the city center.
市中心对汽车通行实施了严格限制。
words.tip: im-（在上）+pose（放）→ 把规定放上去 → 强制实行（同根 compose 组成、expose 暴露）

ex: The company retains the right to modify the contract.
公司保留修改合同的权利。
Older workers often retain valuable experience and skills.
年长员工往往保留着宝贵的经验与技能。
She retained a lawyer to handle the dispute.
她聘请了一名律师处理纠纷。
words.tip: re-（回）+tain（握住）→ 握在手里不放手 → 保留（同根 maintain 维持）

ex: The film depicts the life of a small fishing village.
这部电影描绘了一个小渔村的生活。
The chart depicts the growth of sales over five years.
这张图描绘了五年来销售额的增长。
Witnesses depicted the scene as chaotic.
目击者把现场描述成一片混乱。
words.tip: de-（向下）+pict（画）→ 画下来 → 描绘（同根 picture 图画）

ex: The plan envisages a 20% increase in output by 2030.
该计划设想在2030年前产量增长20%。
It's hard to envisage life without smartphones.
很难设想没有智能手机的生活。
The company envisages expanding into Asian markets.
公司计划拓展亚洲市场。
words.tip: en-（使）+vis（看）+age → 在心中看见 → 设想（同根 vision 视觉）

ex: Preliminary results show the vaccine is highly effective.
初步结果显示疫苗非常有效。
We held a preliminary meeting to discuss the budget.
我们开了个预备会讨论预算。
The preliminary round of the competition starts next week.
比赛预赛下周开始。
words.tip: pre-（前）+limin（门槛）+ary → 门槛之前 → 初步的（同根 eliminate 消除）

ex: The aggregate demand for housing keeps rising.
住房总需求持续上升。
The figures are aggregated at the national level.
这些数据按全国层面汇总。
In aggregate, the cost is about $2 million.
合计起来，成本约200万美元。
words.tip: ag-（向）+greg（群）+ate → 聚成一群 → 聚合、总计（同根 congregation 集会）

ex: Heavy traffic hindered the rescue vehicles.
严重的交通堵塞妨碍了救援车辆。
Lack of funding hindered the development of the project.
资金不足阻碍了项目进展。
Don't let fear hinder you from trying new things.
别让恐惧妨碍你尝试新事物。
words.tip: 联想 behind（后面）→ 把人拖在后面 → 阻碍（近义 hamper 已推送过）

ex: The decision had a huge impact on subsequent events.
这一决定对随后的事件产生了巨大影响。
Subsequent studies confirmed the initial findings.
后续研究证实了最初的发现。
The contract covers delivery and subsequent maintenance.
合同涵盖交付及后续维护。
words.tip: sub-（在…下）+sequent（跟随）→ 跟在后面的 → 随后的（同根 sequence 顺序）

ex: The drug can induce drowsiness, so do not drive.
这种药会引起嗜睡，请勿驾车。
Advertising is designed to induce people to buy.
广告旨在诱导人们购买。
The economic policy induced a wave of investment.
该经济政策引发了一轮投资热潮。
words.tip: in-（进入）+duce（引导）→ 引进去 → 诱导（同根 introduce 介绍、produce 生产）

ex: The storm rendered the roads impassable.
暴风雨使道路无法通行。
We render services to clients in more than 30 countries.
我们为30多个国家的客户提供服务。
The artist rendered the scene in vivid colors.
画家用鲜明的色彩呈现了这一场景。
words.tip: 联想 give 的正式版 → 交出结果 → 使成为、提供（同根 surrender 投降）

ex: The law compels companies to disclose their emissions.
法律强制公司披露排放量。
The evidence compelled the jury to reconsider.
证据迫使陪审团重新考虑。
I felt compelled to tell her the truth.
我觉得不得不告诉她真相。
words.tip: com-（加强）+pel（推）→ 用力推 → 强迫（同根 expel 开除、propel 推进）

ex: A sense of calm prevailed after the crisis.
危机过后，平静的气氛占了上风。
Justice will prevail in the end.
正义终将获胜。
The prevailing view is that prices will keep rising.
普遍看法是物价将继续上涨。
words.tip: pre-（前）+vail（力量）→ 力量在前 → 占上风（同根 valid 有效的）

ex: The CEO reiterated the company's commitment to safety.
首席执行官重申了公司对安全的承诺。
I reiterate: the deadline is Friday, not Monday.
我再重申一遍：截止日期是周五，不是周一。
The report reiterates warnings about climate change.
报告再次警告气候变化。
words.tip: re-（再次）+iterate（说）→ 说了一遍又一遍 → 重申（同根 iteration 迭代）

ex: The festival culminates in a spectacular fireworks display.
节日以一场壮观的烟花表演达到高潮。
Months of negotiations culminated in a landmark agreement.
数月谈判最终达成了一项里程碑协议。
The investigation culminated in the arrest of three suspects.
调查最终导致三名嫌疑人被捕。
words.tip: culmin（顶点）+ate → 登上顶峰 → 达到顶点（culmination 高潮）

ex: In this diagram, the red line denotes the boundary.
在这张图中，红线表示边界。
The term "GDP" denotes gross domestic product.
“GDP”一词指的是国内生产总值。
A red light denotes danger.
红灯表示危险。
words.tip: de-（向下）+note（标记）→ 做标记 → 表示、意指（同根 notation 记号）

words.def: 处理，应对（难题）； tackle 还作名词：擒抱、用具
ex: The government needs to tackle the housing crisis head-on.
政府需要正面应对住房危机。
We tackled the problem by breaking it into smaller tasks.
我们通过把问题拆成小块来处理它。
He tackled the new project with great enthusiasm.
他满怀热情地着手处理这个新项目。
words.tip: 联想“搭（tack）个架子（le）”去解决问题 → 处理、应对（同源 tackle 渔具/装备）

ex: The discovery had a profound impact on medicine.
这一发现对医学产生了深远影响。
She has a profound understanding of human behavior.
她对人类行为有深刻的理解。
The experience left a profound impression on him.
那段经历给他留下了极深的印象。
words.tip: pro-（向前）+found（底）→ 探到底部 → 深刻的（同根 foundation 地基）

ex: The notion that money brings happiness is misleading.
金钱带来幸福这一观念是有误导性的。
He rejected the notion of working overtime every day.
他拒绝了每天加班的想法。
She had no notion of what was about to happen.
她丝毫没意识到将要发生什么。
words.tip: 联想 note（记录）+ion → 记在脑中的一条 → 概念、念头

words.def: 专长；专门知识，专业技能
ex: We hired a consultant with expertise in artificial intelligence.
我们聘请了一位在人工智能方面有专长的顾问。
Her technical expertise is widely recognized in the industry.
她的技术专长在业内广受认可。
The project requires expertise we don't currently have.
这个项目需要我们目前不具备的专业技能。
words.tip: expert（专家）+ise → 专家才有的东西 → 专长

ex: The judge was known for her integrity and fairness.
这位法官以正直和公正著称。
The software checks the integrity of the downloaded file.
该软件会检查下载文件的完整性。
He refused the bribe, showing great personal integrity.
他拒绝了贿赂，展现出极高的个人操守。
words.tip: integr（完整）+ity → 表里如一、完整无缺 → 正直（同根 integrate 整合）

words.def: 不可避免的；必然发生的
ex: With prices rising, inflation seems inevitable.
物价上涨之下，通胀似乎不可避免。
It was inevitable that the two rivals would clash.
两个对手发生冲突是必然的。
Change is inevitable; growth is optional.
改变不可避免，成长则可以选择。
words.tip: in-（不）+evit（避开）+able（能）→ 避不开的 → 不可避免的

ex: Economists are skeptical about the latest growth figures.
经济学家对最新的增长数据持怀疑态度。
I'm skeptical of claims that the product works overnight.
我不相信那种声称产品一夜见效的说法。
She gave him a skeptical look.
她怀疑地看了他一眼。
words.tip: skept（怀疑）+ical → 怀疑的（skeptic 怀疑论者）

ex: The company undertook a major restructuring last year.
公司去年进行了大规模重组。
She undertook the task of rewriting the entire manual.
她承担了重写整本手册的任务。
Researchers undertook a survey of 5,000 households.
研究人员对5000户家庭开展了一项调查。
words.tip: under（在…下）+take（拿）→ 把任务拿到手里 → 承担、着手

ex: Women constitute about half of the workforce.
女性约占劳动力的一半。
Failure to comply constitutes a breach of contract.
不遵守规定即构成违约。
The report constitutes the first official review of the program.
这份报告是对该项目的首次官方审查。
words.tip: con-（一起）+stitute（站立）→ 站在一起 → 构成（同根 constitution 宪法）

ex: The new evidence reinforces our earlier conclusions.
新证据强化了我们早先的结论。
The army sent more troops to reinforce the border.
军队增派兵力加强边境。
Praise can reinforce good behavior in children.
表扬能强化孩子的良好行为。
words.tip: re-（再）+inforce（用力）→ 再加一把力 → 加强（force 力量）

ex: Many English words derive from Latin and Greek.
许多英语单词源于拉丁语和希腊语。
She derives great satisfaction from teaching.
她从教学中获得极大的满足感。
The company derives most of its revenue from exports.
公司大部分收入来自出口。
words.tip: de-（从）+rive（河流）→ 从河里引出 → 获得、源自（同根 river）

words.def: 产生，出产；让步，屈服；产量
ex: The new method yields better results in less time.
新方法用更短时间产出更好的结果。
Farmers are worried about this year's crop yield.
农民担心今年的作物产量。
The manager refused to yield to pressure from investors.
经理拒绝向投资者的压力让步。
words.tip: 联想“田（yield 谐音‘一畝地’）里长出庄稼” → 出产、产量；也让步（同源 two 义项）

ex: The company underwent a major digital transformation.
公司经历了一场重大数字化转型。
She had to undergo surgery on her knee.
她不得不接受膝盖手术。
The building is undergoing extensive renovation.
这栋楼正在大规模翻修。
words.tip: under（在…下）+go（走）→ 从下面走过去 → 经历（同根 go through 经受）

ex: The team won five consecutive games.
这支队伍连续赢了五场比赛。
He has worked three consecutive night shifts.
他连续上了三个夜班。
This is the third consecutive year of declining sales.
这是销售额连续第三年下滑。
words.tip: con-（一起）+secut（跟随）+ive → 一个跟一个 → 连续的（同根 sequence）

ex: Employees want more autonomy in how they manage their time.
员工希望在工作时间管理上拥有更多自主权。
The region was granted greater autonomy from the central government.
该地区获得了中央政府赋予的更大自治权。
School autonomy allows teachers to design their own curricula.
学校自主权让教师能自行设计课程。
words.tip: auto-（自己）+nomy（法则）→ 自己定规则 → 自主（同根 economy 家政/经济）

ex: Good lighting can enhance the mood of a room.
好的灯光能提升房间的氛围。
The company plans to enhance its online services.
公司计划增强其在线服务。
Regular exercise enhances both physical and mental health.
规律运动能同时增进身心健康。
words.tip: en-（使）+hance（高）→ 使变高 → 提高（同根 height 高度）

ex: We must confront the challenge of climate change.
我们必须正视气候变化的挑战。
She confronted her manager about the unfair workload.
她就不公平的工作量当面质问经理。
The country is confronting a severe economic crisis.
这个国家正面临严重的经济危机。
words.tip: con-（一起）+front（前面）→ 站到对面 → 面对（同根 front 前方）

words.def: 故意的；深思熟虑的；仔细考虑
ex: The damage was deliberate, not an accident.
这处破坏是故意的，不是意外。
The jury deliberated for three days before reaching a verdict.
陪审团仔细审议了三天才作出裁决。
Her speech was slow and deliberate.
她讲话缓慢而审慎。
words.tip: de-（加强）+liber（天平）+ate → 放在天平上反复掂量 → 深思熟虑的（同根 liberty 自由）

words.def: 含蓄的，不言明的；内含的
ex: There was an implicit threat in his words.
他的话里暗含威胁。
The contract contains implicit obligations for both parties.
合同包含双方默示的义务。
She had implicit trust in her team.
她对团队有着绝对的信任。
words.tip: im-（向内）+plicit（折叠）→ 折叠在里面 → 含蓄的（反义 explicit 已推送）

words.def: 证明…正当；为…辩护；是…的理由
ex: The cost of the project is hard to justify.
这个项目的成本很难说合理。
He tried to justify his decision to the board.
他试图向董事会证明自己的决定是正确的。
The results justify the extra investment.
这些结果证明了追加投资是值得的。
words.tip: just（公正）+ify（使）→ 使显得公正 → 证明正当（同根 justice 正义）

ex: The ceremony will commence at 10 a.m. sharp.
仪式将在上午10点整开始。
Construction of the new bridge commenced last month.
新桥的建设上个月动工。
The trial is scheduled to commence next week.
审判定于下周开始。
words.tip: com-（加强）+mence（开始）→ 正式开始（正式版 begin；同根 commence 反义 conclude）

ex: The committee finally reached a consensus on the budget.
委员会最终在预算上达成了共识。
There is a growing consensus that remote work is here to stay.
越来越多的人一致认为远程办公将持续下去。
The two parties failed to reach consensus after hours of talks.
双方谈了数小时仍未达成共识。
words.tip: con-（共同）+sens（感觉）+us → 感觉一致 → 共识（同根 sense 感觉、consent 同意）

words.def: 前提，假定；（复数）经营场所
ex: The whole argument rests on a false premise.
整个论证建立在一个错误前提上。
The premise of the movie is simple but powerful.
这部电影的前提设定简单却有力。
Smoking is banned on the premises.
本场所内禁止吸烟。
words.tip: pre-（在前）+mise（放）→ 放在前面的东西 → 前提（同根 promise 承诺）

ex: The drug underwent rigorous clinical testing.
该药物经过了严格的临床试验。
The university has rigorous admission standards.
这所大学有严格的录取标准。
Rigorous training prepared the athletes for the finals.
严格的训练为运动员参加决赛做好了准备。
words.tip: rig（僵硬）+or+ous → 一丝不苟、毫不松动 → 严格的（同根 rigid 僵硬的）

words.def: 微妙的；不易察觉的；巧妙的
ex: There is a subtle difference between the two words.
这两个词之间有细微的差别。
The flavor is too subtle for most people to notice.
这种味道太微妙，大多数人察觉不到。
He used subtle humor to lighten the mood.
他用巧妙的幽默缓和气氛。
words.tip: 联想“sub（下面）+tle” → 藏在表面之下的 → 微妙的（注意 t 不发音：/ˈsʌtl/）

ex: The internet has created a new paradigm of communication.
互联网创造了新的沟通范式。
Her research challenged the dominant paradigm in psychology.
她的研究挑战了心理学的主流范式。
We need a paradigm shift in how we think about energy.
我们需要转变思考能源的方式。
words.tip: para-（旁边）+digm（展示）→ 摆在旁边作示范 → 范式（同根 example 例子）

ex: Higher prices were offset by lower shipping costs.
较高的价格被较低的运费抵消了。
Planting trees can offset some carbon emissions.
植树可以抵消一部分碳排放。
The company offered a raise to offset the extra workload.
公司加薪以弥补额外的工作量。
words.tip: off（离开）+set（放置）→ 一个放这边、一个放那边 → 相互抵消

ex: The project came to a halt due to lack of funding.
由于资金不足，项目停了下来。
Production was halted after the factory caught fire.
工厂起火后生产被叫停。
The driver halted at the red light.
司机在红灯前停了下来。
words.tip: 联想 hold（握住）→ 一把拉住，不让走 → 停止（近义 stop 的正式版）

ex: Analysts speculate that the company may merge with a rival.
分析师推测该公司可能与竞争对手合并。
It's pointless to speculate about the cause of the crash.
猜测事故原因是毫无意义的。
He made a fortune speculating on real estate.
他靠炒房地产发了财。
words.tip: spec（看）+ulate → 观望行情 → 推测、投机（同根 inspect 检查）

ex: The city has a diverse population from many countries.
这座城市拥有来自许多国家的多元人口。
We need diverse opinions to make better decisions.
我们需要多元的意见来做出更好的决策。
The region's climate is remarkably diverse.
该地区的气候极其多样。
words.tip: di-（分开）+verse（转）→ 转向不同方向 → 多样的（同根 version 版本）

words.def: 获得，取得；习得（技能、习惯等）
ex: The company acquired a smaller rival last year.
公司去年收购了一家较小的竞争对手。
Children acquire language at an astonishing rate.
儿童习得语言的速度惊人。
She acquired a taste for coffee while studying in Italy.
她在意大利学习期间养成了喝咖啡的爱好。
words.tip: ac-（去）+quire（寻求）→ 去寻求并得到 → 获得（同根 require 需要、inquire 询问）

words.def: 预期，预料；提前做好准备
ex: Sales are expected to rise more than analysts anticipated.
销售额预计将比分析师预期的增长更多。
We anticipated the problem and prepared a backup plan.
我们预料到了问题，并准备了备用方案。
The team is anticipating a busy holiday season.
团队预计会迎来繁忙的假期季。
words.tip: anti-（提前）+cip（拿）+ate → 提前拿到信息 → 预料（同根 participate 参与）

ex: She attributes her success to hard work and luck.
她把成功归因于努力和运气。
The rise in prices was attributed to higher energy costs.
物价上涨被归因于能源成本上升。
Patience is a key attribute of a good teacher.
耐心是好老师的关键特质。
words.tip: at-（向）+tribute（给予）→ 把功劳给予某人 → 归因于（同根 contribute 贡献）

ex: The airline compensated passengers for the long delay.
航空公司就长时间延误向乘客进行了补偿。
Hard work can compensate for a lack of experience.
努力可以弥补经验的不足。
Nothing can compensate for the loss of a child.
没有什么能弥补失去孩子的痛苦。
words.tip: com-（共同）+pens（称量）+ate → 两边称平 → 补偿（同根 pension 养老金）

ex: The results are consistent across all experiments.
所有实验的结果都是一致的。
She has been consistent in her support for the project.
她对这个项目的支持始终如一。
The team needs consistent effort to win the championship.
球队需要持续的努力才能夺冠。
words.tip: con-（一起）+sist（站立）+ent → 站在一起不散 → 一致的（同根 resist 抵抗）

ex: Timing is crucial when negotiating a deal.
谈判交易时时机至关重要。
This funding is crucial to the project's survival.
这笔资金对项目能否存活至关重要。
The next few weeks will be crucial for the economy.
接下来几周对经济来说十分关键。
words.tip: cruc（十字）+ial → 处在十字路口 → 关键的（同根 cruise 巡航）

ex: The new software eliminates the need for manual data entry.
新软件消除了手动录入数据的需要。
The team was eliminated in the first round of the tournament.
该队在锦标赛首轮就被淘汰了。
We need to eliminate waste from the production process.
我们需要消除生产过程中的浪费。
words.tip: e-（出）+limin（门槛）+ate → 赶出门槛外 → 排除、淘汰（同根 limit 界限）

ex: New evidence emerged during the investigation.
调查过程中出现了新的证据。
The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
太阳从云层后露了出来。
She emerged as the clear winner of the election.
她在选举中脱颖而出，成为明显的赢家。
words.tip: e-（出）+merge（沉）→ 从水中浮出 → 出现（同根 submerge 淹没）

ex: One mile is equivalent to about 1.6 kilometers.
一英里约等于1.6公里。
The two positions carry equivalent levels of responsibility.
这两个职位承担同等的责任。
The Chinese yuan is the equivalent of the dollar in the U.S.
人民币在美国就相当于美元。
words.tip: equi-（相等）+val（价值）+ent → 价值相等 → 等同的（同根 equal 相等）

words.def: 根本的，基础的；基本原则
ex: There is a fundamental difference between the two systems.
这两种制度之间存在根本差异。
Understanding grammar is fundamental to learning a language.
理解语法是学习语言的基础。
The company made fundamental changes to its strategy.
公司对其战略做了根本性的改变。
words.tip: fund（底）+amental → 打地基的 → 根本的（同根 foundation 基础）

ex: His silence implied agreement with the plan.
他的沉默暗示他同意这个计划。
Are you implying that I'm not qualified for the job?
你是在暗示我不胜任这份工作吗？
The report implies that costs will keep rising.
报告暗示成本将持续上升。
words.tip: im-（向内）+ply（折叠）→ 意思折叠在里面 → 暗示（同根 apply 应用、comply 遵守）

ex: Innovation is essential for long-term business growth.
创新对企业的长期增长至关重要。
The phone's camera was a major innovation at the time.
这款手机的摄像头在当时是一项重大创新。
The company invests heavily in research and innovation.
该公司在研究创新上投入巨大。
words.tip: in-（使）+nov（新）+ation → 使变新 → 创新（同根 novel 新颖的）

ex: The report aims to give an objective view of the situation.
这份报告旨在客观呈现局势。
Our main objective this year is to expand overseas.
我们今年的主要目标是开拓海外市场。
It's hard to stay objective when your own money is at stake.
当自己的钱有风险时很难保持客观。
words.tip: object（物体）+ive → 像物体一样不掺感情 → 客观的；也指“目标”（对比 subjective 主观的）

ex: She plans to pursue a career in medicine.
她打算从事医学事业。
The company is pursuing new markets in Asia.
公司正在开拓亚洲新市场。
The police pursued the stolen car for miles.
警察追赶被盗的汽车追了好几英里。
words.tip: pur-（向前）+sue（跟随）→ 一路跟随 → 追求（同根 suit 诉讼/套装）

words.def: 脆弱的，易受伤害的；易受攻击的
ex: Children are the most vulnerable members of society.
儿童是社会中最脆弱的群体。
The system is vulnerable to cyberattacks.
该系统容易受到网络攻击。
Without a support network, she felt vulnerable and alone.
没有支持网络，她感到脆弱而孤独。
words.tip: vulner（伤口）+able → 容易受伤的 → 脆弱的（同源 wound 伤口）
